sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Replace the presence-only quantity checks with a bounded formula constraint. The COMPLETE dependency contract requires nonHemisphericalImpactContactArea as the operand and designIceThickness as the result, both on the ship; the candidate instead treats equivalentImpactSphereRadius as the result and never validates the required equation. Compare the reported derived result against the expected formula value using tolerance scaled from the expected value, while retaining the required M2 and M units and avoiding exact decimal equality.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Replace the presence-only quantity checks with a bounded formula-derived constraint. Follow the COMPLETE dependency contract exactly: use nonHemisphericalImpactContactArea as the operand and designIceThickness as the result, and implement the supplied comparison model/equation with the correct operands and direction. Compare the reported result against the expected formula value using a tolerance scaled from the expected value, not exact decimal equality or a tolerance based on the reported value. Do not treat equivalentImpactSphereRadius as the result unless the dependency contract is corrected upstream. Retain the ship target and the declared metre/square-metre quantity validation, preferably constraining each quantity to one numeric value and one unit.

Reject and regenerate the model/shape using the supplied nltl:equivalentImpactSphereRadius as the derived result; designIceThickness is not the equivalent impact sphere radius, so the COMPLETE dependency contract also requires correction. Encode applicability to evidenced non-hemispherical impacts rather than requiring the formula inputs on every ship, and use only the verified equation rather than an unsupported inferred formula. If sqrt(A/pi) is verified, compare the reported radius against tolerance bounds scaled from that expected result and detect both upper and lower deviations; the current near-zero branch misses lower-side errors and can accidentally pass. All needed candidate terms are already supplied, so no vocabulary matcher is required.
